repository_intelligence.purpose: Small registry and task-based setup index for discovering external LiveKit starter templates and configuring selected examples.
repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Use to shortlist LiveKit examples, then inspect the selected upstream template and its dependencies before setup.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Reviewed all six files. The repository contains template metadata and setup tasks that fetch/use external examples; it is not itself a voice SDK, agent server or full template implementation.
repository_intelligence.license_notes: Apache-2.0 for this index; external templates have independent terms.
risk_notes: Template entries are references; setup tasks may retrieve and execute external project workflows when invoked.

important_subsystems.name: template registry
important_subsystems.purpose: Records external template references and metadata.

important_subsystems.name: setup task configuration
important_subsystems.purpose: Defines commands used to initialize selected templates.

capability_clusters.name: LiveKit starter discovery
capability_clusters.description: Catalogues external LiveKit templates for voice and realtime application patterns.

capability_clusters.description: Provides task configuration to initialize selected external examples.
